Someone else swings.
_correctedWhy_20260908: ⛑ CORRECTED BY ERIK, 2026-09-08: 'The Hollow King should have SUMMON AND COMMAND crafts then. Anyone who has OTHERS FIGHT FOR HIM. He had to have enough to have ASCENDED in the first place… he wanted to never have to take again and be given everything — THAT DOESN'T MEAN HE CAN'T.' ⛔ AEVI TURNED A REFUSAL INTO AN INCAPACITY. The lore says he REFUSED the Angelic and TOOK the whole Demonic half — ⚠️ a choice, made by something already powerful enough to make it. You do not reach a Sovereign seat by being unable. ⚑ WHAT HE WILL NOT DO IS TAKE. HE STILL COMMANDS WHAT HE WAS GIVEN — and the crafts were all sitting in his own domains: `called_form` (command + summon), `descent` (his hall answers him), `honest_bargain` (the promise kept to the letter IS the binding, and the binding commands), `offered_mouth` and `churns_gift` (what is handed to him), `choir_sustains` (he makes what fights for him STRONGER). ⚠️ AND HIS OWN `threading` ALREADY SAID IT: 'HIS RIFFRAFF ARE LESSER BARGAINERS WHO FORESHADOW HIM… never fought head-on.' ⛑ Not-fought-head-on is not defenceless — IT MEANS SOMETHING ELSE IS IN FRONT OF HIM, and that something was given.
_harmThroughOthers: ⚑ HE FIELDS THREE HARM VERBS AND EVERY ONE IS SOMEONE ELSE'S HAND. ⛔ `offered_mouth` is the sharpest: 'the Abyssal Choir's first offense — HARM BY ACQUAINTANCE. What eats was always going to eat.' ⚠️ SOMETHING ELSE DOES THE EATING AND HE INTRODUCED YOU. ⚑ `struck_term`'s strike is THE PRICE LANDING, not a blow he throws — you agreed to it. And `soul_stare` shows a thing its own ending. ⛑ SO THE DESIGN HOLDS EXACTLY AS ERIK CORRECTED IT: he is not defenceless and he never takes with his own hands. ⛔ No fist, no edge, no thrown weapon — and everything that harms through him was either GIVEN to him or ASKED FOR by you.
_vocationWhy: ⛔ `vocation` IS AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED, and the attempt to derive it is the reason. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-08: clustering 40 authored people by their crafts' verb families put SEVENTEEN OF FORTY in KEEPER and ZERO in EDGE — with KESTRIN, THE COLISEUM'S HARM CHAMPION, IN THE KEEPER COLUMN. ⛑ Rank-weighting did not fix it: she reads KEEPER 24 / READER 23 / EDGE 21, essentially flat. ⚑ THE CAUSE IS CLEAN: every capable person carries defensive and perceptive crafts, so verb counts measure COMPETENCE, not PURPOSE. ⛔ A VOCATION IS WHAT A PERSON IS FOR, and that is a judgement — the same shape as `tier`, which a regex also cannot mint. ⬜ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` holds the eight and what each does when a fight starts. ⚑ HERE: ⛔ 'he never takes; he is given.' The Demonic seat.
